title: Floyd's Cycle Detection Algorithm - Medium
snippet: Two pointers (slow and fast) start at the head. Slow moves one step at a time, fast moves two steps. If there is a cycle, fast eventually catches up to slow; if there is no cycle, fast reaches the end (None) first.

title: Detect cycle in a linked list (Floyd's Cycle Detection Algorithm) - TechieDelight
snippet: The algorithm runs in O(n) time and O(1) space, making it more efficient than using a visited-set to track seen nodes.
